summary: Right lower lung field, previously densely opacified in PRIOR, shows visible aerated lung markings in CURRENT.

findings.rationale: PRIOR right lower zone is homogeneously white/opaque with obscured vessels; CURRENT shows re-emergent vascular markings in the same region, suggesting decreased basal opacity/effusion. Caveat: the two exams differ substantially in field of view and magnification, limiting confident localization.
